c1-30-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Room for Manoeuvre
c1-30-01.scenario: A friend asks you how much the neighbouring great powers limited the room for manoeuvre of the states of the Carpathian Basin.
c1-30-01.prompt: Tell your friend that the rivalry of the great powers narrowed the room for manoeuvre, and that the buffer zone made the risk higher.
cues: Say how much the rivalry narrowed the room for manoeuvre
Say what happens to the risk in a buffer zone
c1-30-01.target: A nagyhatalmak versenye számottevően szűkítette a mozgásteret. Az ütközőzónában a kockázat drasztikusan megnő.
c1-30-01.english: The rivalry of the great powers markedly narrowed the room for manoeuvre. In a buffer zone the risk rises drastically.
c1-30-01.canDo: I can say how much a neighbouring power limits a state with *számottevően*, *drasztikusan* or *szembeötlően*.

c1-30-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Law and Power
c1-30-02.scenario: A friend asks you what a good legal order does, and what the historians' term for the old liberties of towns means.
c1-30-02.prompt: Tell your friend what a legal order that limits power does, and what the liberties received from the king meant for the towns.
cues: Say what a legal order that limits power protects
Say what the liberties received from the king meant for the towns
c1-30-02.target: A hatalmat korlátozó jogrend védi a polgárok szabadságát. A királytól kapott városi szabadságok a polgárosodás alapját jelentették.
c1-30-02.english: A legal order that limits power protects the citizens' liberty. The urban liberties received from the king were the basis of civic development.
c1-30-02.canDo: I can describe a legal order with a participle before the noun, as in *a hatalmat korlátozó jogrend*.

c1-30-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views
c1-30-03.scenario: A friend asks you whether shared decision-making limits the sovereignty of a state.
c1-30-03.prompt: Tell your friend that the question is disputed: give the view that it limits sovereignty and the view that it increases the capacity to act.
cues: Give the opposite view in contrast
c1-30-03.target: Egyesek szerint a közös döntéshozatal korlátozza a szuverenitást. Ezzel szemben mások szerint növeli a cselekvőképességet.
c1-30-03.english: According to some, common decision-making limits sovereignty. In contrast, according to others it increases the capacity to act.
c1-30-03.canDo: I can present two views of a disputed question with *egyfelől … másfelől* and *… szerint … viszont*.

c1-30-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why an Alliance?
c1-30-04.scenario: A friend asks you why states form an alliance and why allies train together.
c1-30-04.prompt: Tell your friend the aim of common defense and why the allies train together.
cues: Give the aim of the common defense
Say why the allies train together
c1-30-04.target: A szövetség tagjai azzal a céllal vállalnak közös védelmet, hogy egyik tag se maradjon egyedül. Közösen gyakorolnak, nehogy a támadó azt higgye, hogy gyenge a szövetség.
c1-30-04.english: The members of the alliance undertake common defense with the aim that no member stays alone. They train together so that an attacker does not think the alliance is weak.
c1-30-04.canDo: I can give the aim of an alliance with *azzal a céllal, hogy*.

c1-30-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Ferry and Bridge
c1-30-05.scenario: A friend who has read about Ady Endre's Komp-ország asks where the image comes from and what a bridge would change.
c1-30-05.prompt: Tell your friend where the Komp-ország image comes from and what a bridge in place of the ferry changes.
cues: Say where the image comes from
Say how much a bridge changes the traffic
c1-30-05.target: A Komp-ország kép Ady Endre egy 1905-ös írásából származik. A híd alapjaiban megváltoztatja a két part közötti forgalmat.
c1-30-05.english: The Komp-ország image comes from a 1905 text by Ady Endre. A bridge fundamentally changes the traffic between the two banks.
c1-30-05.canDo: I can say how much something changed with *alapjaiban*, *számottevően* or *jelentős mértékben*.

c1-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up East and West
c1-30-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a talk about the Carpathian Basin, a friend asks you what you learned.
c1-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what the rivalry of great powers did to the room for manoeuvre, and give two views of a disputed question.
cues: Say how much the rivalry limited the room for manoeuvre
Give one view of the disputed question
c1-30-consolidation.target: A nagyhatalmak versenye számottevően szűkítette a mozgásteret. Egyesek szerint a közös döntéshozatal korlátozza a szuverenitást, mások szerint viszont növeli a cselekvőképességet.
c1-30-consolidation.english: The rivalry of the great powers markedly narrowed the room for manoeuvre. According to some, common decision-making limits sovereignty; according to others it increases the capacity to act.
c1-30-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words of geopolitics, regional history and alliances.
